findings.statement: Replay takes project files from tree C, but warrant archive computes MERGED->ARCHIVED gates before openspec archive and records ARCHIVED after it (REQ-VER-008): tree C always has the Change dir moved. required-artifacts-present (openspec status) differs from recorded PASS: RECORD_MISMATCH on honest SCN-VER-091. Round 3 F-7 (edits committed with the transition) is the same gap, not closed.
findings.recommendation: Replay files and policy from the tree the gates saw (C^1 plus own writes of the command) or require a clean tree; add an ARCHIVED replay scenario.

findings.statement: Replay of MERGED takes the evaluated commit by REQ-VER-007 from C^1: --commit is not recorded, so it is the freshest Change record of tree C. With ARCHIVED in the same C (SCN-VER-091) that is the spec-report on C^1, giving COMMIT_NOT_MERGED. SCN-VER-093 instead finds M from CI records of evidence[].
findings.recommendation: For replay of MERGED the evaluated commit = common subject.commit of the transition evidence[]; state it in REQ-VER-011.

findings.statement: Replay runs the HEAD CLI on policy of tree C. After a CLI minor bump the pack kernel range of older trees rejects it (CONFIG_INVALID, I-156): APPROVED/IMPLEMENTING of the 4c impl-PR (bump in group 1, after them) and any PR crossing a bump on main get code 3. Gate logic changed by the PR itself also diverges.
findings.recommendation: State the CLI-version rule of replay (kernel range not enforced in replay, or record CLI version and report drift as finding); add scenario.

findings.statement: Base of replayed non-MERGED transitions is by REQ-VER-007 from C^1, which defines base only for MERGED; default merge-base(HEAD, main) needs a local main, absent in the CI checkout (ci.yml). base_commit STALE and scope-valid then diverge.
findings.recommendation: Define replay base for non-MERGED transitions as merge-base(C^1, HEAD^1).

findings.statement: Every new transition is replayed, but PROPOSED (no gates, no effective_policy_hash in record), backward transitions and ABANDONED have no gates to recompute; comparing hash or gate set gives RECORD_MISMATCH on each new record of a spec-PR.
findings.recommendation: State which transitions are replayed and which fields are compared for transitions without gates.

findings.statement: SCN-VER-105 expects warrant ci on an archive-PR to recompute APPROVED, but only transitions absent from the base record are replayed; APPROVED is in the base record, so the THEN is unobservable.
findings.recommendation: Move the scenario to an impl-PR whose new APPROVED is checked after expires_at.

findings.statement: REQ-VER-003 finds M for replay on the first-parent line of HEAD^1; REQ-VER-011 sets replay HEAD = C^1.
Local warrant ci on impl (design: debug via git merge --no-ff) writes attestation none records and has no current attempt, so every L1 gate fails; not stated.
Ref check needs produced_by.id of human-approval = merged_by, but MERGED without human-approval gate (below HIGH) has no such record: pass or reason by?
Replay repeats transition, which writes human-approval before gates; not said that replay reuses the recorded one (a new one would displace the evidence[] id).
Waiver expiry in replay trusts at of the transition, a hand-editable field; a backdated at hides an expired waiver.

assumptions.statement: required-artifacts-present calls openspec status for the Change, which fails once it is archived.
Pack kernel range is checked against the running CLI version (I-156, phase-4a).
